summary: Tested Registro IVA vendite, the Registro IVA acquisti regression and Liquidazione IVA (monthly and quarterly), backend and frontend, on a deterministic TEST_T12 dataset for 2026. Sales: F1 1000@22 in Jan; F2 500@22 + 200@10 in Feb; NC1 TD04 -100@22 in Mar; F3 PA split 1000@22 in Apr; F4 100@22 in May (mancata_consegna, private client); F6 in Aug (scartata, excluded); F7 100 N2.2 + 200@22 in Oct; F8 draft (excluded). Purchases: 5 fixture invoices (471.25 + 103.68 VAT) registered, with data_registrazione Jan 20, Mar 10, Mar 11, May 5 and Oct 31; 1 left da_registrare (excluded). Backend: 11/11 new pytest tests pass. Regression iteration 7 + 11 passes 39/39. Registro vendite: only inviata/consegnata/mancata_consegna rows; order is invoices then NC; TD04 amounts are negative; totali are 22% (6 docs, 2700/594), 10% (1, 200/20) and N2.2 (1, 100/0); imposta 614; imposta_split 220. The dal/al filter works and invalid dates are ignored. Other years and other companies return empty results; operatore can read. Registro acquisti: same keys plus imposta_split, sorted by protocollo, date filter OK. Liquidazione mensile: totale_versare 246.32, credito_finale 370.72; credit carry, split exclusion and the negative NC month were all checked month by month. Trimestrale: Q1 saldo 16.96 + 0.17 interest = 17.13, Q2-Q4 credit carried, credito_finale 141.36. A Q4 positive saldo (78.64) gets no interest. An invalid periodicita returns 422; no auth returns 401. Frontend (desktop 1920): nav entries, vendite table, rows and totals, split note (shown for full year and April, hidden for Q1), period select (T1, M4, M8 shows empty), invoice link goes to /fatture/{id}, print media (sidebar and controls hidden, company header shown). Registro acquisti page (5 rows, March filter). Liquidazione page: all cells match the API; switching to trimestrale shows the Interessi column; switching to year 2025 shows zeros. All test data was cleaned (0 leftovers).

minor.issue: The minimum payment threshold is not applied. Under Italian rules, if a period's amount due is ≤ 25.82 € it is not paid but added to the next period. In the test, Q1 shows da_versare 17.13 €, which a real F24 would not pay.

The previous year's VAT credit is not carried into January/Q1: credito_precedente always starts at 0 each year. Consider reading the previous year's credito_finale, or allowing a manual opening credit.

data_registrazione is always today. Users cannot register a late-received invoice into an earlier period (or choose the date), and that date drives the purchase side of the liquidazione. Consider an optional data_registrazione in the body, validated ≥ document date.

Reverse-charge purchases (natura N6.x) are listed with 0 VAT. The self-assessed VAT is not posted on either side (vendite/debito and acquisti/credito). This is acceptable for an MVP, but the prospetto is incomplete for companies with reverse charge.

issues: The year selector is always the last 5 calendar years, while the registri use 'anni' from the data. This is inconsistent, but harmless.

action_items: Optional: apply the 25.82 € minimum threshold (carry the amount due to the next period) in liquidazione-iva
Optional: support the previous-year opening credit in liquidazione-iva
Optional: allow choosing data_registrazione when registering a passive invoice
critical_code_review_comments: liquidazione_iva loads up to 50000 sales and purchases into memory and buckets them in Python. That is fine at this scale; a Mongo aggregation would scale better.

Scartata invoices keep their number, so the vendite register shows a gap in numbering (e.g. 5/2026 missing) until the scartata invoice is corrected and resent. This is expected, but the page note could mention it.
RegistroIvaAcquisti.jsx serves both registers through the vendite prop. The code is clean, and riva-row ids differ (invoice id vs protocollo) as specified.
seed_data_creation: TEST_T12 users/sessions (random run id), companies 'TEST_T12 Iva Srl' (P.IVA 01234567890) and 'TEST_T12 Vuota Srl', and the invoices/parties/passive invoices described in the summary. All removed by clean_all() / seed_ui_t12.py --clean. Verified 0 leftovers.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Run: cd /app/backend/tests && pytest test_iteration12_iva.py -n 0. seed() in that file builds the known dataset; the expected numbers are documented in test_08/test_09. UI seed: python seed_ui_t12.py prints TOK/CID/invoice ids (cookie session_token, localStorage fe_company_id); python seed_ui_t12.py --clean. The system date is 2026-10-31. Purchase dates are moved via mongo after the PATCH to registrata. Radix select options: click them with get_by_role('option', name=...) for reliability.
